mapper.select: SELECT d.model_code AS modelCode, d.display_name AS modelName, v.version AS activeVersion, v.algorithm, v.train_from AS trainFrom, v.train_to AS trainTo FROM quant_model_definition d LEFT JOIN quant_model_version v ON v.model_code = d.model_code AND v.is_active = TRUE WHERE d.model_code = 'MP_CORE' AND d.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY v.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: id, model_code AS modelCode, model_version_id AS modelVersionId, signal_date AS signalDate, asset_code AS assetCode, asset_name AS assetName, market, sector, winner_prob AS winnerProb, neutral_prob AS neutralProb, loser_prob AS loserProb, score, rank, target_weight AS targetWeight, reason::text AS reason, risk_flags::text AS riskFlags, created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT r.strategy_id AS "strategyId", r.from_date AS "fromDate", r.to_date AS "toDate" FROM quant_backtest_result r JOIN quant_strategy s ON s.id = r.strategy_id WHERE s.name_en = #{strategyNameEn} ORDER BY r.to_date DESC, r.from_date DESC, r.strategy_id LIMIT 1

WITH latest AS ( SELECT r.strategy_id, r.from_date, r.to_date FROM quant_backtest_result r JOIN quant_strategy s ON s.id = r.strategy_id WHERE s.name_en = #{strategyNameEn} ORDER BY r.to_date DESC, r.from_date DESC, r.strategy_id LIMIT 1 ) SELECT r.strategy_id AS "strategyId", r.trade_date AS "tradeDate", r.portfolio_value AS "portfolioValue", r.return_pct AS "returnPct" FROM quant_backtest_result r JOIN latest l ON l.strategy_id = r.strategy_id AND l.from_date = r.from_date AND l.to_date = r.to_date ORDER BY r.trade_date

WITH latest AS ( SELECT r.strategy_id, r.from_date, r.to_date FROM quant_backtest_result r JOIN quant_strategy s ON s.id = r.strategy_id WHERE s.name_en = #{strategyNameEn} ORDER BY r.to_date DESC, r.from_date DESC, r.strategy_id LIMIT 1 ), monthly AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', r.trade_date)::date AS month_date, FIRST_VALUE(r.portfolio_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY date_trunc('month', r.trade_date) ORDER BY r.trade_date ) AS first_value, FIRST_VALUE(r.portfolio_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY date_trunc('month', r.trade_date) ORDER BY r.trade_date DESC ) AS last_value FROM quant_backtest_result r JOIN latest l ON l.strategy_id = r.strategy_id AND l.from_date = r.from_date AND l.to_date = r.to_date ) SELECT DISTINCT to_char(month_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS "month", CASE WHEN first_value = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (last_value - first_value)::numeric / first_value END AS "returnPct" FROM monthly ORDER BY "month"

WITH latest AS ( SELECT r.strategy_id, r.from_date, r.to_date FROM quant_backtest_result r JOIN quant_strategy s ON s.id = r.strategy_id WHERE s.name_en = #{strategyNameEn} ORDER BY r.to_date DESC, r.from_date DESC, r.strategy_id LIMIT 1 ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ABS(t.amount)), 0) AS "totalTurnover", COALESCE(AVG(ABS(t.weight)), 0) AS "avgTurnover", COALESCE(SUM(t.commission), 0) AS "totalFee", COALESCE(SUM(t.tax), 0) AS "totalTax", COALESCE(SUM(t.commission + t.tax), 0) AS "totalCost", COUNT(t.id) AS "tradeCount" FROM latest l LEFT JOIN quant_trade_log t ON t.strategy_id = l.strategy_id AND t.from_date = l.from_date AND t.to_date = l.to_date

SELECT id, strategy_id AS strategyId, from_date AS fromDate, to_date AS toDate, trade_date AS tradeDate, asset_code AS assetCode, asset_name AS assetName, asset_type AS assetType, trade_type AS tradeType, price, quantity, amount, weight, reason, commission, tax, created_at AS createdAt FROM quant_trade_log WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} ORDER BY trade_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
